why: The D3a reference (examples/reexec-v3-d3) with a normaliser that fixes every state-witness freedom (ignored fields, receipt-proof entries, reachable base_state values) but keeps the witness file's contract-code list as sent. nearcore (and RelD3) append the code blobs to the main recorded storage as a hash-indexed store, so the blobs' order, duplicates and blobs no executed contract needs (unneeded real code, garbage, empty blobs) are free: reordering, repeating or padding the code list gives a second accepted proof of the same claim. Sound, certificate genuine (soundness and completeness hold for any normaliser), but malleable: the judge's code-blob witness-freedom mutants must find it.
notes: Submit against near-chunk-v3 with declared_tier D3a. Derived case: BASE examples/reexec-v3-d3 with formal/ReexecV3D3/Canon.lean replaced (canonW keeps the code list verbatim). Locally: every public positive with >= 1 code blob yields accepted code reorder / duplicate / junk / empty mutants.
